note: Pantheon Wars ships no image, audio or font files. All art and sound are generated by code at runtime; this manifest lists every drawing id, where it is drawn and what uses it.
audio: ui/audio.js: Web Audio synthesis (oscillators and noise), original motifs per pantheon; no samples.
resolution: v0.4: standing objects (village kits, shrines, priests, landmarks) are authored at 2x in ui/kits.js and drawn in screen space at their world size, so at normal zoom one source pixel is about one screen pixel; sizes and ground anchors are in each kind. v0.6: flat ground and ridged hills in ui/terrain-art.js, redrawn event subjects, heraldic patterns and tapestry; v0.5: tall terrain features in ui/terrain-art.js (2×, baked at 1× and drawn at 2× in screen space), forty power manifestations in ui/vfx-art.js (live in screen space), minted icons and emblems, recomposed event scenes and pilgrims.
